marks.note: Fixed-color (#10B866 literal) brand marks, not currentColor sprite symbols -- consumed as standalone /inline SVG, not via BrandIcon's sprite mechanism, and intentionally not added to sprite.svg.

files.name: brokoli-symbol-micro.svg
files.purpose: Optically reinforced (heavier stroke/terminal weight than the master mark) for product chrome at <=24px, e.g. the sidebar brand tile. Do not use above 24px -- use the master mark (favicon.svg) instead.
